stories.title: Big 4 firms report surge in Indian deal advisory revenue
stories.summary: The Big Four firms, including Deloitte, PwC, EY, and KPMG, are expanding their transaction advisory services in India. Revenue from these services across the four firms reportedly exceeded 10,000 crore in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026, as deal activity in the region continues to grow.

stories.title: Big 4 expand Indian advisory teams to meet deal demand
stories.summary: The Big Four are scaling local advisory teams to handle M&A, taxation, and post-acquisition work. EY now counts over 300 partners in its Indian deals business, while Deloitte has roughly 150 partners in its local practice. The firms are positioning themselves to capture a rising volume of transactions.

stories.title: Cognition and McKinsey partner on enterprise AI software
stories.summary: Cognition and McKinsey are collaborating to help enterprises measure the business impact of AI in software development. While McKinsey reports that some organizations see productivity gains of over 2x from AI, 30 percent of surveyed leaders reported a decline in productivity after adopting the new tools.

stories.title: Cognition and McKinsey team up to sell Devin to large companies
stories.summary: Cognition and McKinsey have formed an alliance to sell AI software engineering services to large companies in the US and Europe. McKinsey will advise clients on project selection and workflow redesign, while Cognition provides Devin, an AI agent that performs coding tasks for human review.

stories.title: Accenture India freezes base pay while offering performance bonuses
stories.summary: Accenture has introduced performance-linked bonuses of up to 26 percent for top-performing employees in India as part of its November rewards cycle. However, the company has kept base salary increments and promotions on hold, prioritizing variable compensation over fixed cost increases for its workforce.

stories.title: Accenture India prioritizes variable pay over salary hikes
stories.summary: Accenture has rolled out performance-linked bonuses of up to 26 percent for top-rated staff in India, even as routine salary increments and promotions remain paused. The firm, which employs roughly 40 percent of its global workforce in India, is focusing its current rewards cycle on variable cash.

stories.title: PwC US launches critical thinking certification for 85,000 staff
stories.summary: PwC US is introducing a critical thinking and judgement certification for 85,000 employees. The firm notes that as AI tools take over foundational research and analysis tasks, junior staff may lose the everyday opportunities they once had to develop professional judgement through manual work.

stories.title: PwC to spend $100 million on critical thinking training
stories.summary: PwC is launching a $100 million certification program to teach 85,000 employees how to exercise judgement when using AI. The initiative aims to address the loss of foundational skills as AI increasingly automates the research and analysis tasks previously performed by junior staff members.

stories.title: KPMG appoints eight new partners across Africa
stories.summary: KPMG has appointed eight new partners across its African operations, effective October 1, 2026. The appointments span the firm's audit, advisory, and tax practices in Southern and Eastern Africa. The company stated the move reflects its confidence in future opportunities within the region.

stories.title: Indian music economy reaches $1.8 billion
stories.summary: Music-related economic activity in India hit $1.8 billion in 2025, a 45 percent increase over two years, according to an EY study. Independent artists accounted for 43 percent of digital streams, up from under 35 percent in 2023, as total digital listening reached six trillion tracks.

stories.title: McKinsey projects 3x returns for banking AI agents
stories.summary: Banks deploying agentic AI could see returns of nearly three times their initial investment over three years, according to a McKinsey report. The firm analyzed 52 use cases for autonomous AI systems, projecting that banks could recover their costs in approximately 10 months of implementation.

stories.title: Wharton and Accenture find most AI tasks do not require frontier models
stories.summary: A joint report from Wharton and Accenture suggests that over 90 percent of tasks suitable for AI agents can be handled by less expensive models. The study of 18,000 work activities found that only 6 percent to 11 percent of tasks require the most powerful frontier AI.

stories.title: BCG ranks India as an AI rising contender
stories.summary: Boston Consulting Group has named India an AI rising contender, citing a large pool of skilled specialists and an IT workforce experienced in managed-delivery processes. The firm noted that India's position is built primarily on human talent rather than high-end compute infrastructure.

stories.title: Deloitte report finds AI adoption no longer provides competitive edge
stories.summary: Deloitte's Asia Pacific report suggests that widespread AI accessibility means adoption alone is no longer a differentiator for businesses. Based on a survey of 1,278 leaders, the firm concludes that while AI is abundant, originality remains scarce and is the only factor that sets organizations apart.

stories.title: McKinsey identifies $4 trillion in trade vulnerabilities
stories.summary: McKinsey Global Institute research suggests that $4 trillion of global imports, or nearly a quarter of the total, are vulnerable to supply chain disruptions. The firm categorizes these products as the Achilles' heel of global trade, noting that many face at least two significant supply risks.

stories.title: Healthcare administrators struggle to measure AI returns
stories.summary: Nearly two-thirds of healthcare administrators expect quantifiable returns from AI within three years, with many dedicating up to 25 percent of IT budgets to the technology. Despite the spending, only 40 percent report an ability to clearly measure the return on their AI investments.

stories.title: Physician satisfaction reaches record low
stories.summary: Physician sentiment has deteriorated, with the employee Net Promoter Score falling to 6 in 2026, the lowest level recorded by Bain since 2017. The firm notes that clinician involvement is a critical enabler for AI success, yet one in four physicians currently wants to switch employers.

stories.title: Healthcare providers face clinician and consumer attrition
stories.summary: Healthcare systems are struggling with low clinician satisfaction and shifting consumer loyalty. Nearly one-third of consumers sought care at different systems in the last year, while one in four physicians is considering leaving their employer. The report suggests AI could help if implemented effectively.

eClerx to buy RegEdge for up to $12 million
stories.summary: eClerx is acquiring U.S. regulatory consultancy RegEdge for up to $12 million in cash. The price includes upfront and performance-linked payments for the firm, which reported $5.1 million in revenue for 2025. The deal is expected to close within two weeks. Payments are often linked to performance.

3LS acquires New York-based consultancy
stories.summary: 3LS has acquired an unnamed New York-based consultancy for an undisclosed sum. The local professional services company completed the purchase in November 2026. The financial details of the transaction remain private.

stories.title: Decasult acquires BF Strategy
stories.summary: Montreal-based Decasult has acquired project risk management firm BF Strategy. Decasult described the purchase of the 20-employee boutique consultancy as a significant milestone in its growth trajectory. The firm provides risk and governance expertise to government agencies and municipalities. Milestones are frequently defined by the buyer.

stories.title: Acuity Analytics buys data consultancy Continuus
stories.summary: Permira-backed Acuity Analytics has completed the acquisition of U.S. data consultancy Continuus. The target firm focuses on enterprise data strategy, governance frameworks and cloud transformation programs for financial institutions. The deal was finalized in October 2026.

stories.title: LEO Pharma to acquire dersimelagon rights for $435 million
stories.summary: Nordic Capital-backed LEO Pharma is acquiring the rights to the drug dersimelagon from Bain-owned Tanabe for $435 million. LEO Pharma describes itself as a global leader in medical dermatology, serving nearly 100 million patients annually across more than 70 countries.

Bevolve partners with Deloitte India for ESG reporting
stories.summary: ESG platform Bevolve has partnered with Deloitte India to integrate its AI capabilities into sustainability service delivery. The collaboration aims to help organisations manage data at scale and improve reporting quality. Sustainability data is now being turned into actionable business insights.

stories.title: Indian conglomerates centralise operations via GCC model
stories.summary: Indian conglomerates including Adani, Tata and Mahindra are adopting the Global Capability Centre model to centralise technology, finance and human resources. The shift aims to standardise processes and drive digitisation. While no specific adoption numbers exist, the trend is reportedly gaining momentum across sectors.

Semiconductor industry faces talent shortage in India
stories.summary: Boston Consulting Group and CIEL HR Services estimate that India may create over 100,000 semiconductor jobs within three years. However, the industry faces a significant talent gap, as the country struggles to produce experienced engineers for specialised factory roles as quickly as it attracts investment.

Shivam Pathak joins Bayer as public affairs lead

stories.title: Priyank Sinha joins PwC Acceleration Center India as director
stories.summary: Priyank Sinha has joined the tax innovation and delivery excellence division at PwC Acceleration Center India as director. He moves from IG Group, where he spent nine months leading technology for innovation and platforms. His career includes work in AI engineering and digital transformation.
